clues.it: Anna era l'unica seduta su una sedia e a nord di Paolo.
clues.en: Anna was the only one sitting on a chair and north of Paolo.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 6ª colonna e accanto a un cactus, ma non era accanto a un cavallo.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 6th column and beside a cactus, but was not beside a horse.

clues.it: Sergio era l'unica persona su una sputacchiera e nella stessa stanza di Carla.
clues.en: Sergio was the only person on a spittoon and in the same room as Carla.

clues.it: Marta era a nord di Irene e nell'Ufficio dello Sceriffo.
clues.en: Marta was north of Irene and in the Sheriff's Office.

clues.it: Irene era accanto a una cassaforte e a ovest di Bruno.
clues.en: Irene was beside a safe and west of Bruno.

clues.it: Paolo era in una stanza diversa da Olga e nelle Stalle.
clues.en: Paolo was in a different room from Olga and in the Stables.

clues.it: Carla era nella 2ª colonna, nella 7ª riga e nelle Stalle.
clues.en: Carla was in the 2nd column, in the 7th row and in the Stables.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Olga era nella 1ª colonna e accanto a un pianoforte, ma non era accanto a un bancone.
clues.en: Olga was in the 1st column and beside a piano, but was not beside a bar counter.

clues.it: Bruno era accanto a una sella e in una stanza diversa da Marta.
clues.en: Bruno was beside a saddle and in a different room from Marta.
